sense: the head of a company or organization

terms.gloss: the director (of a company), the head
evidence: Cic. Fam. 13.9.2: quī est magister in eā societāte
M-O s.v. corporation: president of a corporation, CEO
terms.comment: The head of a Roman company was its magister (Lewis & Short); with a genitive, the head of anything: magister societātis.

terms.gloss: the person put in charge, a director
evidence: Plaut. Bacch. 425: gymnasī praefectō, to the director of the gymnasium
terms.comment: One put in charge (praeficere, see in charge).

phrases.latin: quī est magister in eā societāte
phrases.english: who is the director of that company
the founder of the biggest companies and the director of a great many

sources: Lewis & Short: magister · Lewis & Short: praefectus
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. corporation: president of a corporation, CEO; overseer: manager, director.
